<!--
Submitting an encoding? Everything you need:

  1. Put your folder at submissions/<your-name>/ -- encode.py and
     submission.json, plus an optional memory/ folder of notes.
     Schema and the encode(spec) contract: inbox/README.md
  2. Change NOTHING else. A PR that mixes a submission with other edits is
     rejected automatically -- open a separate PR for those.
  3. Open the PR. CI verifies your encoding at every size you claim and
     reports the scores here. You do not need to run anything locally,
     though scripts/submit_baseline.py lets you check first if you like.

Nothing is published until a maintainer merges; the numbers that reach the
leaderboard are recomputed by a trusted run after merge.
-->

**What is this?**
<!-- One line: the idea behind the encoding. -->

<!-- square-lattice (default) / graph (hexagonal, triangular, ...) / ancilla-stabilizer -->

**Anything worth knowing?**
<!-- Optional: what you tried, what plateaued, what surprised you. If it's
substantial, consider putting it in memory/ so it's carried into the
permanent record and indexed in MEMORY.md for the next person. -->
